comment: Reviewed classification of every Trimble API definition outside the Trimble-Connect SwaggerHub organisation. scripts/fetch-trimble-other-specs.py discovers definitions on every page of every developer.trimble.com product section and of developer.trimblemaps.com, on the App Xchange connector pages, and from the direct, documented, Vista and Identity sources below. cmd/trimble-catalog fails if a discovered definition matches no rule, if a rule matches nothing, or if discovery recorded an error.

unavailable.reason: linked from the Procore connector page but returned HTTP 500 on 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-01
linked from the Sage 300 CRE connector page but returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-01

ops.summary: Get all projects owned by the account (account administrators only)
Get all users in projects owned by the account, with their project counts
Get the projects a user is a member of, with activeProjectsCount
Create a job that adds or removes users across projects (account administrators only)
Upload a document as Base64 (3 MB limit)
Import non-cost process dynamic grid rows
Update budget change status (the definition names this /StatusUpdate)
Update commitment change status (the definition names this /StatusUpdate)

safety.reason: safety: sends a work order or prescription (application map) to the in-cab device of a vehicle, which can drive field machinery; the bridge never plans or performs anything that reaches machinery

safety: sends a resource file (guidance lines, boundaries, vehicle and implement profiles) to in-cab PTx displays that guide field machinery; the bridge never plans or performs anything that reaches machinery
safety: imports a prescription (application map) that is sent to the in-cab devices named in deviceIds; a plan cannot tell whether the job targets devices, so neither step is planned

safety: changes the routing, configuration or map data that in-cab CoPilot navigation uses for a group of vehicles (including creating a group with default profiles, moving vehicles between groups, or deleting a group); a qualified fleet administrator must make such changes
safety: changes a vehicle routing profile (dimensions, weights, hazardous materials) that in-cab navigation uses to route trucks; a qualified fleet administrator must make such changes
safety: signs in, issues, renews, validates or revokes credentials, or stores a password or client secret; agents never handle credentials (as for Trimble Identity)
safety: changes GNSS receiver, antenna, correction or position-stream settings on a field device; positioning that guides survey or machine work must be configured by a qualified person on the device
